notes.title: Psycho Fear Update 1.35 is Here!
notes.content:
Psycho Fear Update 1.35 is Here! 

We’re excited to share what’s new in Psycho Fear with our latest update! This version adds fresh content, improved gameplay mechanics, and more challenging encounters to keep you on the edge of your seat.

🔸 New Puzzles in Level 2: Two new puzzles have been added to Level 2 to intensify the challenge.

🔸 Timed Doors in Maze Corridors: Two timed doors now await you in the maze corridors of Level 2. 

🔸 New Lore Note: Discover more of the dark lore with a new note added to Level 2.

🔸 Usable Objects: All accessible objects in Level 2 are now usable, so interact and see what you find!

🔸 Final Boss AI Improvement: The final boss has become even more fearsome! It now patrols back and forth. Stay vigilant!

🔸 Redemption in the Final Corridor: Redemption is now possible in the final corridor, adding a new layer to the end-game experience.

🔸 Hints for the Painting Puzzle in Level 3: Struggling with the painting puzzle? We’ve added hints in Level 3 to guide you.

🔸 Level Selection Menu in Lobby: A level selection menu has been introduced in the lobby to give players a sneak peek of the upcoming map!

Update now and dive back into the chilling world of Psycho Fear. See if you have what it takes to survive the horrors that await!

notes.title: Psycho Fear New Content Update v1.3 - Out Now!
notes.content:
Psycho Fear Update v1.3 - Out Now!

This update brings exciting new content and important fixes:

- 2 new random puzzles added alongside the current puzzles in Level 1, offering 4 different ways to 
  complete the level.

- 1 new puzzle added in the basement of Level 1.

- New jump scares added across the levels.

- Added the ability to stack pills and bandages in the inventory.

- Fixed the door shaking bug in co-op mode across all levels.

- Various improvements and fixes made to the translations.

notes.title: Upcoming Update for Halloween!
notes.content:
Hello, Psycho Fear community!

We're excited to announce that our next update is scheduled for Halloween! 

We are currently preparing a bigger update with lots of new content, including new puzzles, new environments, and new characters. One exciting addition is the inclusion of randomized puzzles, offering an unprecedented replayability experience. 

We also want to take the necessary time to thoroughly test all the new features to ensure we're delivering the best quality experience possible.

Thank you for your patience and continued support!

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.251
notes.content:
- Ventilation Grid Issue in Level 4: We fixed a bug where the ventilation grid in level 4 was not functioning as expected. Players will now be able to interact with this element correctly.

- Level Streaming Fix: A problem with level streaming has been resolved. Transitions between different areas of the game will now be seamless, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.

notes.title: Psycho Fear New Content Update v1.25 - Out Now!
notes.content:
Psycho Fear Weekly Content Update

We’re excited to announce the latest content update for Psycho Fear, bringing more intensity and depth to your experience!

- Expanded Level: One of the game’s levels has been increased in size and filled with new content, adding more challenge and excitement.

- New Lore Note: A new piece of lore has been added, deepening the game’s story and providing more clues for you to uncover.

- New Items: Additional items are now available, offering more tools to help you in your survival.

- More Interactive Items: We've made more items in the game world interactive, giving you more ways to engage with the environment.

- Translation Fixes: Several translation issues have been corrected for a smoother experience in multiple languages.

- Gameplay Fixes: A variety of gameplay fixes have been implemented to improve overall performance and mechanics.

We hope these updates will enhance your journey through Psycho Fear. 
Keep an eye out for future updates as we continue to improve and expand the game.

notes.title: Psycho Fear New Content Update v1.2 - Out Now!
notes.content:
Psycho Fear Update v1.2 - Out Now!

As promised to our community, here is the second of the weekly content updates that we will be releasing!

 This update brings exciting new content and important fixes:

- Two game levels have been completely revamped with new rooms and puzzles, adding more gameplay time. 
- Several puzzles are now randomized, aiming to make all puzzles in the game unpredictable.

We also implemented several fixes, including:

- The loading and unloading of levels in co-op mode.
- A fix for redemption in level 1.
- Improved crouching mechanics.
- A fix for the blurry note texture.
- Correction of baby rotation.
- Adjustments to the painting puzzle in level 3.
- Fixes for sound effects (SFX).
- Plus many other minor text tweaks and refinements.

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.12
notes.content:
We’ve just rolled out a new hotfix to enhance your gameplay experience and address a few issues. Here’s what’s been updated:

- New On-Screen Text for Paintings: We’ve added helpful text on-screen to guide you through the 
  painting puzzles more easily.

- Lore Text Update: Additional lore details have been added for an even richer narrative experience.

- Reactive Floor Tiles: We’ve improved the feedback for the reactive floor tiles, giving you clearer clues

- Flashlight Adjustments: The flashlight has been fine-tuned for better visibility and smoother 
  transitions in darker environments.

Thank you for your continued support, and as always, let us know if you encounter any further issues. Stay sharp, the challenges only get tougher from here!

notes.title: Psycho Fear New Content Update v1.1 - Out Now!
notes.content:
Psycho Fear Update v1.1 - Out Now!

As promised to our community, here is the first of the weekly content updates that we will be releasing!

We are excited to announce the release of the Psycho Fear v1.1 update! This update brings exciting new content and important fixes:

- A brand new puzzle has been added, hidden in a location for you to discover.

- One of the current puzzles has been revamped with fresh new mechanics to keep you on your toes.

- A new piece of lore has been introduced in one of the levels, offering deeper insights into the game's 
  backstory.

- We've added two new small rooms for players to explore.

- A significant input settings fix has been made, and you can now customize your look inputs.

- Several minor issues reported by the community have also been fixed.

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait for you to experience these new additions and improvements!

notes.title: Psycho Fear Evolves for an Even More Intense Experience!
notes.content:
We heard you, and we made it happen! You asked for more flexibility, and it's here with the Redemption update.

- In solo mode, death is no longer the end. Face the challenges, explore the levels without the fear of a game over. And now, the amount of karma is no longer an obstacle for redemption. But be warned—each redemption still comes with a price...

- In co-op mode, solidarity prevails! We've added the redemption system just like in solo mode, so now you and your team can support each other in the face of danger. Unity is strength, even in the face of the worst horrors.

Psycho Fear is a living, evolving game, constantly shaped by your feedback. Keep sharing your thought we love hearing from you! And above all, brace yourself for new scares, because we’re far from done surprising you...

notes.title: Hotfix look control
notes.content: Hello, we have modified a file related to the input that may prevent players from looking around with the mouse and gamepad.

notes.title: Exciting News for Psycho Fear Fans!
notes.content:
The heart-pounding terror of Psycho Fear has captured the attention of horror enthusiasts everywhere, and we're thrilled to see so many of you diving into this chilling experience! Your feedback has been invaluable, and we're committed to making this game even better.

Here's what's coming your way:

- Longer Playtime: Next week, we'll be releasing an update that increases the game's playtime. You asked for more time to explore the spine-tingling world of Psycho Fear, and we've listened! Prepare to face your fears for even longer.

- A Living Game: Psycho Fear is not a static experience. Expect frequent updates that will introduce new challenges, unexpected twists, and keep you on the edge of your seat. The game you know today may evolve in surprising ways with each update.

- Thank You! We're incredibly grateful for the overwhelming support and positive reception Psycho Fear has received. It's been amazing to see so many players embracing the terror and sharing their experiences. We couldn't have done it without you!

Stay tuned for more updates and prepare to face your deepest fears in the ever-evolving world of Psycho Fear!
